cases.name: danger-at-rest
cases.evidence: rendered in the app: .ghost.danger resting colour rgb(255,77,106) = --bad, border --bad-dim. Red before the pointer arrives.

cases.name: danger-dialog-runtime
cases.evidence: rendered: .primary.danger is background --bad with --on-bad text (5.9:1 dark, 5.3:1 light, measured). The rule survives and the dialog's OK button reaches it at runtime.

cases.name: failed-filter-hides-errors
cases.evidence: driven: with one downloading and one errored row, the Failed chip leaves the errored row visible, hides the running one, and keeps the failed list. The bug hid the errored row.

cases.name: library-collapse-source-order
cases.evidence: mutation: the pre-fix two-column rule was re-injected at 759 and produced 77 overflowing elements including .lib-body+140; removing it returned to 0.

cases.name: duplicate-summary
cases.evidence: live page has 0 duplicate ids, and the stylesheet has exactly 1 bare .summary block. Both are also guarded by tests: test_ids_exist.py and test_classes_exist.py.

cases.name: insights-since-date
cases.evidence: python tests/test_insights.py - a library filled to HISTORY_LIMIT reports capped=true and the subtitle reads 'the last 300 files ... older ones are not kept'; under the limit it does not.

cases.name: firstrun-on-upgrade
cases.evidence: python tests/test_first_run.py - a settings file with no first_run_done key reads as already answered; disabling that path turns the check red.

cases.name: grab-counts-navigation
cases.evidence: python tests/test_grab_skipped.py - two off-site unreadable links are counted and the page's own relative navigation is not.

cases.name: bad-as-gradient-end
cases.evidence: grep of app.css: zero linear-gradient declarations still ending in var(--bad). The three were the tab marker, the backdrop and the progress fill.

cases.name: faux-bold
cases.evidence: live page: no element computes above font-weight 500, and only the 400 and 500 faces ship, so no synthesised bold is possible.

cases.name: unstyled-chip-em
cases.evidence: rendered: .chip .chip-size computes font-style normal at 10px, not the browser's default italic.

cases.name: palette-to-settings-row
steps: open the palette from a room that is not settings
the settings room opens, the row is scrolled to and marked
cases.evidence: driven from the library: Ctrl+K, typed 'Downloads at once', Enter -> ended in view-settings with the row carrying .has-hit and the palette closed.

cases.name: filter-then-reopen
steps: the chip and the list still agree
cases.evidence: driven: Failed chip picked in Activity, left for the library, returned - chip still 'failed' and the same single row visible.

cases.name: theme-flip-with-overlay-open
steps: the dialog repaints in the new theme
cases.evidence: driven: Insights open, dark dialog rgb(11,13,17) -> light rgb(237,238,241). It repaints.

cases.name: narrow-then-widen
steps: narrow to 1024 so the rail collapses
the rail's labels and the active marker come back
cases.evidence: driven: 1440 rail 320 labels block marker indent 22px -> 1024 rail 72 labels none indent 0 -> back to 1440 rail 320 labels block indent 22px with the marker drawn.
